title: O.J Simpson Doubles Down On His Stance That He's Not Khloe Kardashian's Father & Denies Any Affair With Kris Jenner [Watch]
htmlContent:
O.J. Simpson is once again denying the age-old rumors that he slept with Kris Jenner and fathered Khloe Kardashian, explaining why that can't be true she's not his type.

The Juice tackled speculation in an interview on the podcast Full Send, where he was asked about the gossip he and Kris may have had an affair while O.J. and Robert Kardashian were still good friends before the murder trial.

O.J. says there's nothing real about the idea that he hooked up with Kris, explaining that he was never attracted to her and didn't think she was attracted to him. Not to mention that she was married to Bob back then…So that's it.

He also categorically denies being Khloe's father despite years of people suggesting that he could be. O.J. says he knows nothing about it but leaves open the possibility that someone else might be his father mentioning a "cook" rumor he heard.

"I always thought Kris was a cute girl. She was really nice. But, you know… I was — I was dating supermodels!” He continued, “but the rumor ain’t true. Nowhere even close to being true.” The host then mentioned that “some people think you might be Khloe Kardashian’s real dad.” 

Anyway, O.J. is true to his story, which he already told in front of the camera.

Three years ago, Simpson wrote on Twitter, “You know, Bob Kardashian, he was like a brother to me. He was a great guy.”

“He met and married Kris and they really had a terrific time together, when they were together. Unfortunately, that ended. But never — and I want to stress, never, in any shape or form — have I ever had any interest in Kris, romantically or sexually, and I never got any indication that she had any interest in me. So all of these stories are bogus, bad, tasteless.”
